nodes.label: PPNeueMontreal — Single typeface across all UI contexts. Display sizes (78–113px) carry headlines at weight 400 with -0.04em tracking — the same weight as body text but massive scale creates hierarchy. Weight 200 (ultra-light) is reserved for 18px body copy, a signature choice: most AI/SaaS sites use 400 for body, but Dala strips weight to make paragraphs feel airy and non-aggressive. Weight 600 at 14px with 0.025em tracking and uppercase serves nav and small labels. The number 400 doing both 113px display and 15px body is unusual — it means the brand trusts scale, not weight, for hierarchy. · `--font-ppneuemontreal`
